title: The sharpness gate's blur is equal to the bit to its first version, and its verdicts from worker threads equal the main thread ones
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The rewritten blur gives the same floats to the bit as the first version, for tiny, narrow and large pictures and both sigmas.
A verdict from the worker pool equals judgePhoto on the main thread, corrected bytes included; several at once all come back; an unreadable picture fails its own verdict and the pool keeps working.
The sharpness gate's own verdict tests still pass.

tests: the blur gives the same floats to the bit as the first version, edges and tiny pictures included
the blur of a large picture, both sigmas the gate uses, is equal to the first version
a verdict from the pool equals the main thread one, corrected bytes included
several verdicts asked at once all come back, each the one asked for
a picture the gate cannot read fails its own verdict and the pool keeps working
